title: Surf Session Wave Count and Conditions
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surf:session
| stats sum(waves_caught) as waves, avg(swell_m) as swell, sum(paddle_km) as paddle by session
| eval waves_per_hr=round(waves/(duration_min/60),1)
| sort - _time
description: Logs waves caught, paddle distance, and swell size each surf session, mapping your sessions to the conditions.
value: Linking wave counts to conditions helps you learn which swells suit you and get the most from each session.
implementation: Ingest surf-watch sessions into `index=personal`; review waves and conditions per session.
visualization: Table of surf sessions with waves caught and swell.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how many waves you caught and the conditions each surf, helping you pick the best days.
